moment.text: The Blessed Agostino Novello Triptych is a tempera on panel painting by Simone Martini, produced for a church in Siena between 1324 and 1328, at which time he had just returned from Assisi, Pisa and Orvieto to work on his frescoes at the Palazzo Pubblico.

Should it be a question, however, whether he or Lippo painted it, we might affirm that, if by the latter, it is the best he ever produced, and one in which he successfully equalled his great relative.
